name: tech-radar-knowledge-base-tests
description: A local-first Markdown knowledge base with searchable pages, explicit-link graphs, community views, and reproducible health checks.

scripts.refresh:artifacts: python3 scripts/build_index.py && python3 scripts/render_graph.py && python3 scripts/check_health.py && python3 scripts/taxonomy_cli.py validate
scripts.test:all: npm run refresh:artifacts && npm run test:python && npm run test:e2e:all
scripts.test:e2e:local: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/conda/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH} playwright test tests/web_workbench.spec.cjs tests/desktop_experience.spec.cjs tests/taxonomy_observability.spec.cjs --config tests/playwright.config.cjs --reporter=line
